name: Brittany Harris Gymnastics Camps

description_short: Short commuter gymnastics camps for girls ages 7-18 (beginner to elite), run by the Brown University Women's Gymnastics coaching staff and held at Ocean State School of Gymnastics in Lincoln, RI. Gymnasts get skill instruction from the coaches and current Brown gymnasts.

refund_policy_summary: No refund for any reason unless Registration Protection is bought at registration. A $70 administrative fee applies to every cancellation, and there are no refunds within 7 days of camp.
